mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and CPIAUCSL is above 3% YoY, the mismatch signals a potential inflation overshoot, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a stable unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE is stable, but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST consistently increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
